label: Spatial-information research, 1991–1993
basis: Peter G. Firns worked in Computer and Information Science at the University of Otago. He co-authored a 1991 study of semantic data models with George Benwell and Philip Sallis. Otago’s archived research record lists his 1993 SIRC paper on semantic data modelling and spatial relationships.

sources.label: Benwell, Firns and Sallis, Deriving Semantic Data Models from Structured Process Descriptions of Reality, 1991
